# What is an extension?

## Someone else already solved it

::: {.incremental}
- An extension is a folder of Lua, JavaScript, and CSS that Quarto knows how to load
- It ships as a GitHub repo, and you install it by name
- Nothing to configure globally, it lives inside your project
:::

::: {.fragment}
Every styled code block you have seen today came from one.
:::

## Installing

::: {.codewindow .codewindow-dark width="70%"}
Terminal

```bash
quarto add emilhvitfeldt/quarto-revealjs-codewindow
```
:::

::: {.incremental}
- Downloads into `_extensions/` next to your `.qmd`
- Commit that folder, it is part of the project
:::

## Codewindow

:::: {.stage}

::: {.codewindow .codewindow-dark .quarto .fragment .stage-exit data-fragment-index="1"}
my-deck.qmd

````markdown
---
revealjs-plugins:
  - codewindow
---

## Some code

::: {.codewindow .r}
analysis.R

```r
mtcars |>
  group_by(cyl) |>
  summarize(mean_mpg = mean(mpg))
```
:::
````

## checklist-fragments

## timeline

Events on a line, horizontal or vertical, panning as you step through them.

:::: {.stage}

::: {.codewindow .codewindow-dark .codewindow-scroll .quarto .fragment .stage-exit data-fragment-index="1"}
my-deck.qmd

````markdown

filters:
  - timeline
---

## How it went

::: timeline
::: {.event data-label="2020"}
**Project Started**
:::
::: {.event data-label="2021"}
**First Release**
:::
::: {.event data-label="2024"}
**Version 2.0**
:::
````

## editable

Move, resize, restyle, and retype anything on a rendered slide, then save it back to the source.

:::: {.stage}

::: {.codewindow .codewindow-dark .quarto .fragment .stage-exit data-fragment-index="1"}
my-deck.qmd

````markdown
---
revealjs-plugins:
  - editable
filters:
  - editable
---

## Move me around
````

## reveal-auto-agenda

Builds an agenda slide from your sections, and repeats it between them.

:::: {.stage}

::: {.codewindow .codewindow-dark .quarto .fragment .stage-exit data-fragment-index="1"}
my-deck.qmd

````markdown
---
filters:
  - reveal-auto-agenda
---

# Collecting the data

## A slide

# Fitting the model

## Another slide
````

## flourish

Styles individual words *inside* a code chunk: highlighted, masked, or underlined.

:::: {.stage}

::: {.codewindow .codewindow-dark .quarto .fragment .stage-exit data-fragment-index="1"}
my-deck.qmd

````markdown
---
filters:
  - flourish
---

## Picking out a word

```{{r}}
#| flourish:
#| - target: "mean"
#| echo: true
mean(mtcars$mpg)
```
````
:::

::: {.fragment .stage-enter data-fragment-index="1"}
<iframe src="examples/ext-flourish.html#/picking-out-a-word" title="The rendered flourish slide"></iframe>
:::

::::

::: {.fragment}
By Kelly Bodwin and Visruth Srimath Kandali. Pair it with roughnotation to annotate code.
:::

::: footer
<https://github.com/kbodwin/flourish>
:::

## The registry

[quarto-extensions](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-extensions) lists what the community has built.

::: {.incremental}
- Searchable listing, one row per extension
- Badges tell you whether something is stable, experimental, or abandoned
- Adding your own is a one-line pull request
:::
